items.exampleEn: He is an amateur photographer who works in a bank.
items.exampleZh: 他是一位在銀行上班的業餘攝影師。

items.exampleEn: In chess, you must always think about the next move of your adversary.
items.exampleZh: 下西洋棋時，你一定要隨時想到對手的下一步。

items.exampleEn: The victorious players lifted the cup above their heads.
items.exampleZh: 獲勝的球員們把獎盃高舉過頭。

items.exampleEn: Working dogs on farms have amazing stamina.
items.exampleZh: 農場上的工作犬有驚人的耐力。

items.exampleEn: The hotel has a room for billiards and table tennis.
items.exampleZh: 這間飯店有一間可以打撞球和桌球的房間。

items.exampleEn: Trampoline parks have become popular places for children's parties.
items.exampleZh: 彈跳床樂園已經成為辦兒童派對的熱門地點。

items.exampleEn: The dancer ended her show with a perfect somersault.
items.exampleZh: 那位舞者以一個漂亮的筋斗結束了表演。

items.sentenceEn: Running a marathon requires a lot of stamina.
items.sentenceZh: 跑馬拉松需要很好的耐力。

items.audioEn: The children jumped on the trampoline in the garden all afternoon.
items.audioZh: 孩子們整個下午都在花園裡跳彈跳床。
items.questionZh: 孩子們整個下午在做什麼？
options: Playing cards at home with friends

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather played billiards with his friends every Friday night.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺每個星期五晚上都和朋友打撞球。

items.sentenceEn: The little boy did a somersault on the soft grass.
items.sentenceZh: 那個小男孩在柔軟的草地上翻了一個筋斗。

items.stemEn: After a long, tough match, the home team was finally ____.
items.stemZh: 經過一場漫長又艱苦的比賽，主隊終於獲勝了。

items.stemEn: In the final, she faced her old ____ from the national championship.
items.stemZh: 在決賽中，她碰上了全國錦標賽時的老對手。

items.passageEn: Ben is an amateur athlete who practices gymnastics at a sports center after work. He started on the trampoline as a child, and now he can do a double somersault. Training takes a lot of stamina, so he also runs three times a week. He loves the adrenaline of competing. Last month, he took part in a regional event against his old adversary, Max, who had beaten him twice before. This time, Ben was victorious by just half a point. To celebrate, the two men played billiards together and agreed to meet again next year.
items.passageZh: Ben 是一位業餘運動員，下班後在運動中心練體操。他小時候從彈跳床開始練，現在已經能做兩圈的空翻。訓練需要很好的耐力，所以他每週也會跑步三次。他熱愛比賽時那種腎上腺素飆升的感覺。上個月，他參加一場地區比賽，對上曾經贏過他兩次的老對手 Max。這次，Ben 以僅僅半分之差獲勝。為了慶祝，兩人一起打了撞球，並約好明年再一較高下。

questions.questionZh: Ben 小時候是從什麼開始練的？

items.promptZh: 這是一場業餘比賽，所以參加不用付錢。
referenceEn: This is an amateur competition, so it is free to enter.
It's an amateur contest, so you don't have to pay to take part.
rubricZh: amateur 當形容詞表示「業餘的」（例如 an amateur competition、amateur players 等）
「不用付錢」可寫，例如 it is free、you don't have to pay 等

items.instructionZh: 用 stamina 造一個句子，說說你在某件事上的耐力。
referenceEn: I don't have the stamina to hike for more than three hours.
Swimming every week has given me more stamina.
rubricZh: stamina 表示「耐力、體力」，是不可數名詞（例如 the stamina to…、more stamina 等）
